about: The group CPA-V-06 of the converged Claude practice audit, copied verbatim from the full file, which stays in the private research record; no digest of that file is published here, because a digest of bytes that are not published binds nothing a reader can check (docs/decisions/2026-10-12-mcp-instruction-cap.md cites this excerpt).

group.title: ai-memory's MCP instruction block is cut at the client's cap
group.mechanism: The block is longer than the 4,096-character default, so its routing text for memory_status and every later tool never reaches the model.

sources.part: part b: the truncated ai-memory block

claims.how: this analyst session's own ai-memory instructions end in a truncation marker after the memory_status line
host settings env has no CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH

claims.claim: ai-memory offers no shorter instruction mode

pr.name: mcp-description-cap
pr.scope: Add CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH to the settings template env at the smallest value that fits the block measured at the pinned ai-memory version; the CC installs. The knob raises the cap for every server's descriptions and instructions, which the PR states.
pr.owner_lane: cc-native-practice (profile templates); may ride with FIX-3
pr.fail_first_test: A template test: the env key is present and not below the measured block length; it is absent today.

group.next_step: Measure the block length, then the PR.
